perf_experiments/rsqrt_lane_and_window: phase4_bench.py (10 variants across 3 orthogonal levers: window/blocked, SFPU lane scope RC|C|cskip, pass fusion) + test_phase4.py (col0 PCC gate + all-ones absolute check with eps=0.25 + poison cols + bcast<COL> safety probe). Confirmed from eltwise_chain.hpp that block_size is CLAMPED to 1 for Streaming CB-reader chains (policy_supports_block excludes Streaming), so the op pays a full dst-sync window per tile.

Read op kernels + reduce LLK. REDUCE_ROW SUM = MVMUL with scaler->SrcA (transposed) and data->SrcB, so scaler ROW index may select the OUTPUT COLUMN -> column-pack ht row-sums into 1 tile (8x payload cut). BLOCKER RISK: reduce_init programs packer edge mask that ZEROES everything but column 0. Writing a single-core probe to settle the mechanism empirically.

perf_experiments/zone_report.py did all its work at MODULE level. ttnn/ttnn/operations/__init__.py exec_module()s every .py it walks during `import ttnn`, so zone_report parsed sys.argv[1] on every ttnn import -> ValueError -> `import ttnn` (and therefore EVERY pytest in the clone) failed. Wrapped its body in main() + __main__ guard; CLI behaviour unchanged. Also moved my pytest out of ttnn/ttnn/operations/ into tests/ttnn/unit_tests/operations/rms_norm/perf_experiments/rsqrt_lane_and_window/ for the same reason (a test module under operations/ would import torch+pytest on every ttnn import).

ht=8 fp32/fp32 64 cores 32 tiles/core: baseline 29225ns (913.3 ns/tile) == the op cmp_rsqrt MATH 906 ns/tile (0.8% match -> isolation validated). chain_blocked 29173 (1.00x NULL), raw_rc_blk 29204 (1.00x NULL) => the DEST-WINDOW lever is a measured NULL, the 906ns is ALL per-tile SFPU lane work. raw_c 15473 (1.89x), raw_cskip 8997 (3.25x), raw_fused_rc 27627 (1.06x), raw_fused_cskip 8453 (3.46x BEST), raw_fused_cskip_blk 8485. Cost model: accurate-rsqrt ~25 ns per 32-lane vector, add_unary ~1 ns/vector, per-tile copy+pack floor ~65-75 ns. All PCC 0.9999967 (fused 0.9999968 - marginally MORE accurate). bcast<COL> poison probe PASSED: the consumer reads column 0 only.

MECHANISM CONFIRMED on blackhole. (1) reduce_tile REDUCE_ROW scaler face-ROW index h selects the OUTPUT COLUMN h -> ht row-sums column-pack into ONE dest tile in ht FPU ops. (2) reduce_init packer edge mask zeroes cols!=0; reduce_uninit() before pack_tile clears it and the packed tile survives (probe tile 9: live cols {0,1,3}, each 32.0). (3) one-hot scaler at (face-row 0, col k) of faces 0+2 SELECTS input column k into output column 0 -> the unpack is 1 FPU op/tile with 1/W folded into the selector. Max pack factor = 16 (face rows 0..15).

copy+pack-only ablation (payload removed, scaffolding kept): 80.9 ns/tile per-tile window, 63.5 ns/tile blocked. So (a) the per-tile dst-window overhead is only ~17 ns/tile = 1.9% of the 913 ns baseline and is fully HIDDEN behind the SFPU pass once any math is present -> explains why the blocking lever measures NULL; (b) the irreducible accurate-rsqrt lane cost is ~23 ns per 32-lane vector (matches examples/sfpu_tile_scope ~24 ns) and add_unary ~2 ns/vector; (c) option 3 (fold eps+rsqrt into the reduce post_reduce_op so phase 4 is not its own pass) has an ABLATION-MEASURED ceiling of 81 ns/tile = a further 1.44x on top of the best candidate.

colpack: all-ones ABSOLUTE gate FAILED (max err 0.0625, 12.5% of rows short) while PCC would have passed. Hypothesis: cb_partials sees 9 pushes per row-block on the ROOT (8 from the square pass + 1 from my elementwise root sum) against 16 pages, so a multi-page cb_reserve_back straddles fifo_limit and pack_tile (which does not wrap) corrupts. Fix: give the root sum its own CB (index 12) so cb_partials pushes stay 8/row-block into 16 pages.

row_rotate passes at nh_core=1 (block-2048x1024) and ht=1 but hangs at nh_core=4 (focus) => cross-row-block state. Root cause: cb_partial_out (8 pages) receives a MIXED push sequence [ht=8 pass A, ho=1 fold], so fifo wr_ptr lands mid-buffer and the next 8-page push straddles fifo_limit (the exact invariant in the op descriptor docstring). Fix: give the owner fold its own CB (reuse cb_group_partials2 as cb_owner_out, ho_max pages).

My first fused variant scored PCC 0.855. Localized by per-w-tile PCC: w-tile 0 = 0.99998, w-tiles 1..3 = 0.79-0.85. Root cause: ckl::UnaryBcast::exec hard-codes in_tile_index=0 (eltwise_chain.inl:1239) - it always broadcasts the CB FRONT tile and ignores the chain walk index, so a Bulk/CallerManaged lifecycle expands gamma tile 0 WT times. Fix: InputLifecycle::Streaming (wait1/pop1) so the front walks. NOTE: an all-ones-gamma test cannot see this bug - the ramp-gamma gate caught it.
